title: Calcutta High Court: connected OBC-list and reservation matters
html:
22 May 2024

Calcutta High Court: connected OBC-list and reservation matters

WPO 60 of 2011 and connected matters, including WPA 22145 of 2010, WPO 1160 of 2013 and WPO 578 of 2012. The judgment is the legal turning point cited by the later 2025 and 2026 notifications. It should be read directly for the operative directions and the exact scope of the findings.

Bundled judgment copy (211 pp.) Mirror copy; verify against the High Court record.

title: Supreme Court: Aatmadeep’s SLP paper book
html:
28 Jul 2024

Supreme Court: Aatmadeep’s SLP paper book

SLP(C) 16936/2024, Aatmadeep v. State of West Bengal & Ors. The paper book states that it arises from the 22 May 2024 High Court judgment in WPA 8844/2020. It is a party filing, not an order of the Court.

Bundled party paper book (39 pp.) Use for pleadings context; verify every assertion against the court record.

title: Supreme Court: SLP(C) 17751–17755 of 2024
html:
22 Nov 2024

Supreme Court: SLP(C) 17751–17755 of 2024

State of West Bengal & Anr. v. Amal Chandra Das. The bundled official Supreme Court record of proceedings arises from the 22 May 2024 High Court judgment. Use it with the Supreme Court case-status service for the current listing and later orders.

Bundled official order (4 pp.)

title: Supreme Court: broader connected-appeal cluster listed for final hearing
html:
7 Jan 2025

Supreme Court: broader connected-appeal cluster listed for final hearing

The official record groups the State’s main appeal with proceedings involving Tuhina Parvin (Diary 30078/2024), Md. Nawsad Siddique (Diary 31942/2024), Sk. Serafuddin (Diary 31944/2024), Aatmadeep (SLP(C) 16936/2024), Mustafijur Rahaman (SLP(C) 18931–18935/2024), Bengal Madrasah Education Forum (SLP(C) 18926–18930/2024), West Bengal Commission for Backward Classes (Diary 36073/2024), Md. Taiedul Islam (SLP(C) 20849/2024), and Md. Najmul Hoque (SLP(C) 29017–29021/2024). By consent, the Court listed the matters for final hearing on 28 January 2025. The official 5 May 2026 cause list still identifies this connected cluster; this evidence does not establish a final merits disposal.

Bundled official record (5 pp.) · Official 5 May 2026 cause list

title: Calcutta High Court: Aatmadeep PIL and Amal Chandra Das PIL listed together
html:
21 Jan 2025

Calcutta High Court: Aatmadeep PIL and Amal Chandra Das PIL listed together

In WPA(P) 387/2024 (Aatmadeep) with WPA(P) 430/2024 (Amal Chandra Das), the Court recorded a State affidavit about implementation of the 22 May 2024 judgment and allegations that recruitment/admission bodies continued to use the struck-down OBC-A/OBC-B categories. The Court did not determine the merits in this order; it listed the matters for further consideration.

Bundled court-text mirror print (2 pp.) · Original court-text mirror Not a certified or official High Court PDF; verify against the court record.

title: Calcutta High Court: WBJEE PG admission implementation order
html:
21 May 2025

Calcutta High Court: WBJEE PG admission implementation order

In WPA 9132/2025, Supriya Mondal & Ors. v. State of West Bengal & Ors., concerning JEMAS PG 2024–25 admissions, the Court directed the Joint Entrance Board to identify candidates among the 66 pre-2010 classes, recast the panel at 7% OBC reservation, and complete the specified admission steps. The order was later the subject of appeals MAT 943/2025 and MAT 955/2025, referenced in the 7 August 2025 proceeding; this tracker does not treat those appeals as decided.

Bundled court-text mirror print (3 pp.) · Original court-text mirror Not a certified or official High Court PDF; verify against the court record.

title: Calcutta High Court: challenge to the 2025 benchmark-survey process
html:
17 Jun 2025

Calcutta High Court: challenge to the 2025 benchmark-survey process

The order in WPA(P) 111, 119 and 132 of 2025, with WPA(P) 430 of 2024, records challenges to the benchmark survey, the 28 February 2025 Commission memo, the 1 March 2025 district communication, and the 8 and 27 May 2025 notifications.

Bundled High Court order (13 pp.) Source copy; obtain a certified/official court copy when available.

title: Supreme Court: later 2025 appeal record
html:
18 Jul 2025

Supreme Court: later 2025 appeal record

SLP(C) 17528/2025, State of West Bengal v. Amal Chandra Das & Ors. The bundled official office report identifies the related 17 June 2025 High Court order. It is a procedural record, not a merits judgment.

Bundled official office report (3 pp.)

title: Supreme Court: stay of the 17 June 2025 High Court order
html:
28 Jul 2025

Supreme Court: stay of the 17 June 2025 High Court order

In SLP(C) 17422/2025, 17528/2025 and 17973–17974/2025, the Supreme Court issued notice and recorded an interim stay of the 17 June 2025 High Court judgment and order. This is an interim procedural development, not a final disposal of the underlying issues.

Bundled Supreme Court order (3 pp.)

title: Calcutta High Court: JEMAS PG contempt proceedings
html:
7 Aug 2025

Calcutta High Court: JEMAS PG contempt proceedings

The order in CPAN 1362 and 1365 of 2025 records contempt proceedings linked to implementation of the 22 May 2024 judgment and the 21 May 2025 WPA 9132 court-text mirror print. It describes the proceedings and related pending appeals; it should be read for its own operative directions and procedural setting.

Bundled High Court order (12 pp.)

title: Supreme Court: interim stay in the JEMAS PG contempt appeal
html:
22 Aug 2025

Supreme Court: interim stay in the JEMAS PG contempt appeal

In Diary Nos. 45526/2025 and 45628/2025, arising from the 7 August 2025 Calcutta High Court order in CPAN 1362/2025, the Supreme Court issued notice, stayed the impugned order until further orders, and tagged the matters with SLP(C) 17422/2025. This is an interim procedural order, not a decision on the underlying OBC issues.

Bundled Supreme Court order (2 pp.) Local source copy; verify subsequent proceedings.

title: Supreme Court: connected OBC SLPs listed with applications to vacate stay
html:
11 Mar 2026

Supreme Court: connected OBC SLPs listed with applications to vacate stay

An official office report for SLP(C) 17422, 17528 and 17973–17974 of 2025 records that the matters were listed with applications for clarification/direction and for vacation of the interim stay. It also records incomplete service on specified respondents. The official 5 May 2026 cause list again lists the vacation applications. Neither record is a disposal order, and the evidence bundled here does not show that either stay was vacated or that the merits were decided.

Bundled official office report (5 pp.) · Official 5 May 2026 cause list

title: Calcutta High Court: recruitment-category challenges after the 2026 reset
html:
1 Jul 2026

Calcutta High Court: recruitment-category challenges after the 2026 reset

Orders in WPA 14695/2026 (Bistriti Parveen) and WPA 14698/2026 (Yasin Chowdhury) concern candidates who had applied as OBC-A candidates before the 18 May 2026 notifications. The Court directed an extension of the application-editing date while listing the matters for further hearing; the orders do not finally determine the merits.

WPA 14695/2026 order (4 pp.) · WPA 14698/2026 order (4 pp.)

title: Calcutta High Court: PIL challenging the 18 May 2026 notifications
html:
3 Jul 2026

Calcutta High Court: PIL challenging the 18 May 2026 notifications

In WPA(P) 305/2026, Right and Justice Foundation & Anr. v. State of West Bengal & Ors., the PIL challenged Notifications 944 and 945 and Letter 946. The Division Bench declined to entertain the PIL, recording that the Supreme Court was already seized of the principal issues and that the State’s 18 May 2026 decision should be placed before the Supreme Court in the pending SLP.

Bundled High Court order (4 pp.)

title: Calcutta High Court: Bistriti Parveen petition withdrawn
html:
8 Jul 2026

Calcutta High Court: Bistriti Parveen petition withdrawn

In WPA 14695/2026, Bistriti Parveen v. State of West Bengal & Ors., the petitioner stated that she had exercised the option available under the challenged 12 June 2026 notification and sought permission to withdraw. The Court dismissed the writ petition as withdrawn with liberty to file afresh, vacated any interim order, and disposed of connected applications. This is a procedural closure of that petition, not a merits ruling on the OBC classification issues.

Bundled High Court order (2 pp.) Local source copy; verify with the court record.
